about.text: Brian D. Swanson, proceeding pro se, appeals the dismissal of his suit against the Georgia Secretary of State (Secretary), alleging that the 2022 United States Senate runoff election in Georgia was unconstitutional because the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution does not apply in Georgia.
